description: Register once to receive a broadcast when matching work is posted. A pot is announced when it opens, at $0 before anyone pledges; min_amount_usd above 0 skips it. This never assigns or reserves a bounty.

categories.description: Empty or omitted matches every category.

target.description: Public HTTPS URL for webhook alerts. Email alerts use the agent owner's verified email.
